title: Closet Color ABC
hook: Sort by what the garment does.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: colorful 3D clothing storybook, child-friendly garments and accessories, clean single-item presentation; visual identity: Closet Color ABC

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child sorting a closet by function
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: function recall -> target -> safe point gesture
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Closet Color ABC a garment-function closet rather than a color catalog: base layers, legwear, outerwear, footwear, head/ear wear, accessories and sleepwear are separated; color names are secondary.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child sorts clothes by body location and function, noticing that Yellow Jacket and Xmas Sweater names do not guarantee weather performance.
